hook: 界 means boundary: a world inside one boundary, like 芸能界, the entertainment world.
Make the image (像) appear (現): developing film so the picture shows up.
The original (原) rule (則): the basic rule everything starts from.
Buy (購) and bring in (入): you purchase something and take it home.
Tell (告) it plainly (白, clear): a confession of the truth or of love.
Tiny (細) germs (菌): bacteria too small to see.
Appear (現) again (再): reproducing a scene so it happens again.
Pick (採) and choose (択): officially adopting one option from many.
Pick (採) for use (用): adopting an idea or hiring a person.
Shave (削) and decrease (減): cutting costs or numbers down.
Make (作) use (用): the way something works on another thing, its effect.
Examine (討) and argue (論): a debate.
Go a far (遠) way round (回り): taking the long detour.
研 means polish: you sharpen a knife by polishing it on a stone.
A person (亻) at your half (半) side: something that comes along with you.
Take (取) and pull (引): goods and money move both ways in a business deal.
Take (取り) it back (戻す): to get back what you lost.
Grass (艹) over a rice field (田): a young rice seedling.
No (ない) feeling (気) of anything (何) behind it: done casually, without thinking.
Day (日) and night (夜): all the time.
値 means value: 値打ち is how much something is really worth.
Pull (引き) the price (値) down: a discount.
A sword (刀) with an extra mark on its sharp edge: the blade.
Spread (配) your thoughts (慮) to others: care and consideration.
One (一) rule (律) for all: uniform, the same for everyone.
A plan (図) in your mind (意): your intention. Sounds a bit like "intent".
Now (今), after things have gone further (更): "it is too late now".
受 means receive: the school receives you, so you pass the exam.
Receive (受け) and put in (入れる): to accept someone or something.
Big (大) width (幅): a large, drastic change.
Fall (落ち) deep in (込む): your mood drops and you feel down.
訪 is words (言) + direction (方): you go in someone's direction to talk, you visit.
Renew (改) and remake (革): a big reform.
Go around (回) and gather (収): collecting things back.
House (家) calculations (計): the family budget.
傍 is a person (亻) at the side: beside, or doing something on the side.
Feel (感) by touch (触): how something feels to your hand.
Liver (肝) and heart (心), the vital organs: the most important thing.
Air (気) phenomena (象): the weather.
Turn (転) the opposite (逆) way: a reversal, a comeback.
Stuck (窮) and bent over (屈): tight and cramped, no room to move.
Carrying out (行) government (政): administration.
Empty (空) gap (間): space.
Neck (首) ring (輪): a collar, or a necklace.
The same (同) feeling (情) as someone: sympathy.
Resource (資) money (金): funds.
Thing (事) item (項): items or matters on a list.
Before (前) the thing (事): in advance.
Proof (証) in words (言): testimony.
Feeling (情) threads (緒): emotions and the mood of a place.
Feeling (情) threads (緒): emotions and mood; じょうしょ is the older reading of じょうちょ.
Win (勝) and profit (利): a victory.
The place (所) where it exists (在): whereabouts.
Person (人) material (材): the talented people a company needs.
Control (制) and promise (約): limits you must work within.
切 means cut: a feeling so sad it cuts your heart.
攻 means attack: 攻め is the offence, the attacking side.
Proclaim (宣) in words (言): a declaration.
Set opposite (対) and compare (比): a contrast.
Store (蓄) and pile up (積): accumulation.
Long (長) compilation (編): a long novel or film.
Arrange (調) properly (理): cooking food.
Light (軽) in the hand (手): easy and simple.
Hands (手) handed out (配): arranging people and things; also a police search.
A book (本) for your hand (手) to copy: a model to follow.
Connected (連) rest days (休): a run of holidays.
Your original (元) ground (地): your local area, your home town.
Master (修) learning (学): study, as in 修学旅行, a school trip.
Until the end (終) of the day (日): all day long.
Soft (柔) and soft (軟): flexible.
Discipline (修) in practice (行): hard training, like a monk's.
Not (不) good conditions (況): a recession.
Things (物) and resources (資): supplies.
Swing (振り) back (返る): turn your head and look back.
Not (不) good (良): bad, defective, or a delinquent.
Soldier (兵) man (士): a soldier.
Change (変) and move (動): ups and downs, fluctuation.
解 means untie: a knot or string comes undone.
The real (本) place (場): the home of something, where it is genuine.
True (本) name (名): your real name.
Sensing (覚) flavour (味): your sense of taste.
No (無) wire (線): wireless, radio.
Name (名) and praise (誉): honour.
Make it peaceful (和) and soft: to ease pain or soften something.
Evening (夕) getting dark (暮れ): twilight.
Business (用) matter (件): what you came about, what you need.
Steps walked (履) through past time (歴): your history, a log.
Paper (紙) stretched (張り) on a wall: a notice or poster.
反 means against: to go against a rule or wish.
Ten thousand (万) people (人): everybody.
Respond (応) back (反): a reaction.
久 means a long time: it has been long, as in お久しぶり.
People's (人) eyes (目): the public gaze.
Burned (焼け) by the sun (日): sunburn or a tan.
Draw (描) and copy (写): depicting or describing a scene.
割 means divide: one 割 is one part in ten, so 3割 is 30 percent.
片 means one side of a pair: 片手 is one hand.
Old ranking signs: 甲 is like A, 乙 is like B, second place.
証 means proof: 学生証 is the card that proves you are a student.
First of the old ranking signs, like A; also a hard shell, as in 甲羅.
A wine jar (酉) gone sour: acid.
A door (戸) with two wings opening apart (非): a hinged door or gate.
Metal (金) radical: lead, the soft heavy metal, as in 鉛筆 (pencil).
Thread (糸) radical: a net made of string.
寄る means come near: 北寄り is leaning a bit to the north.
営 means run a business: 国営 is run by the state.
Original (原) point (点): the starting point.
The emperor's (皇) residence (居): the Imperial Palace.
Fire (火) + emperor (皇), shining again and again (々): blazing brightly.
Facing (向) upward (上): improvement.
Good (好) review (評): popular, well received.
Small (小) build (柄): a small person.
The source (源) of a word (語): etymology.
The ground (地) of your heart (心): how you feel, as in 居心地.
試 means try: an attempt or trial.
Old (古) age (代): ancient times.
凝 means freeze, set hard: focus your eyes or effort hard on one thing.
A root (根) to hold on to (拠): the basis for a claim.
Root (根) and bottom (底): the very foundation.
Root (根) and origin (本): the root of a problem.
Fine (細) work (工): delicate craftwork, or a trick.
Live (生) again (再): playback or regeneration.
Mixed up (錯) and mistaken (誤): an error, as in 試行錯誤 (trial and error).
定 means fix, settle: to decide or set a rule.
Produced (産) things (物): a product or result.
Doing (仕) it up (上) to the end: the finish.
Do (仕) it up (上げる) to the end: to finish a job.
Awake (覚) to yourself (自): being aware of your own situation.
Treat lightly (軽) and look down on (蔑): contempt.
Pass through (経) a road (路): the route.
Those who come (来) to the house (家) to serve: retainers.
Healthy (健) and whole (全): sound, wholesome.
Reach (到) the bottom (底): even going all the way, it is not possible.
Moving (動) power (力): motive power.
Mouth (口) radical: to chant or recite aloud.
Earth (土) and straw bags (俵): the sumo ring made from them.
Take (取) and handle (扱): how something is handled.
Inner (内) heart (心): what you secretly think.
Inner (内) part (部): the inside.
The name (名) that remains (残): traces left behind.
情 means feeling: kind feeling for others, compassion.
Make (造り) your luggage (荷): packing.
Year (年) congratulations (賀): New Year greetings, as in 年賀状.
Burning (燃) material (料): fuel.
Distribute (配) and supply (給): rationing out food, or releasing films.
Hand out (配) and spread (布): distributing flyers.
One (一) look (見): at first glance.
One (一) heart (心): your whole mind on one thing.
Receive (受け) and stop (止める): to catch, or to take news calmly.
Receiving (受) with your body (身): passive; also the passive voice.
Hit (打ち) and cut (切る): to cut something off, to end it.
Go around (回る) above (上): to exceed.
Projected (映) image (像): pictures on a screen.
Push (押し) in (込む): to cram into.
供 is a person (亻) offering service: the one who goes along with you.
帯 is a belt: to wear something like a belt, to carry or have a tinge of.
A thought (思い) that sticks (付き) suddenly: a sudden idea.
Open (開) and hold (催): holding an event.
Open (開) and clear land (拓): pioneering.
Meet (会) and talk (談): talks between leaders.
Firm (確) belief (信): conviction.
Firmly (確) keep (保): securing something.
微 means tiny: so tiny it is faint.
Hand (扌) radical: to rub or graze.
傾 means lean: to tilt, as in 耳を傾ける (listen closely).
Sing (唱) together (合): a chorus.
Join (合) side by side (併): a merger.
Flower (花) powder (粉): pollen.
Used to (慣) learned ways (習): a custom.
Simple (簡) and plain (素): simplicity.
Danger (危) and harm (害): injury.
A light (軽) spirit (気): casual, easygoing.
A dangerous (危) moment (機): a crisis.
Write (記) and put on (載): an entry in a document.
Both kanji have ox (牛): an animal sacrifice, giving something up.
Metal (金) radical: forge metal, and train your body hard.
Rule (規) fixed (定): a regulation.
Measure (規) and pattern (模): the scale of something.
End (末) of the period (期): end of term.
Supplied (給) food (食): school lunch.
Work (業) results (績): achievements.
Fishing (漁) boat (船).
清 means clean water: pure and clear.
Tight (緊) and hurried (急): an emergency.
禁 means forbid: to prohibit.
Cut (切り) into sections (区): a break or a stopping point.
Foolish (愚) and silly (痴) talk: grumbling.
Light (軽) leading (率): acting without thinking, careless.
Ask (問い) to match up (合わせる): to inquire.
Throw (投) in resources (資): investment.
Time (時) difference (差): the gap between time zones.
Support (支) and hold (持): backing someone.
Hold (持) and continue (続): to keep going.
味 means taste: the flavour you savour.
Change (化) to bad (悪): getting worse.
生 means life: keep alive, or make good use of.
Move (移) where you live (住): migration.
Come out (出) into the world (世): rising in your career.
Detailed (詳) and fine (細): the details.
Up (上) and rise (昇): going up.
